name: When should I call a professional for a clogged drain?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a clogged drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional plumber if home remedies like plungers or store-bought drain cleaners don't resolve the clog. Recurring clogs, foul odors, or multiple slow-draining fixtures often indicate a deeper issue that requires specialized tools and expertise, such as hydro-jetting or snaking. Persistent problems suggest a professional assessment is needed to prevent further damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if home remedies fail, clogs are recurring, or multiple fixtures are affected. Persistent issues often indicate a deeper problem.
